_purpose: What a filing shows about a record whose models read no usable development figure (the review of 2 October 2026, P-10). run_analysis.py (load_and_classify, load_filing_eligibility) reads it. kind 'first_year_nil_opening': a first-year report whose opening reserves are nil, so it has no underwriting year up to t-2 and no eligible outcome; the loader counts it with the first-year reports the extraction skips, and missingness_check.py classifies it as structural. kind 'stated_basis_excluded': the filing states the prior-year movement on a basis the paper excludes (basis 'net' or 'unknown'; the settled net-basis rule, D-9) and no model read a figure; the loader records that basis, so the record is a basis exclusion. Each entry needs two readings of the filing, the pages read and a quote, as the other registers do; an entry marked _to_complete is skipped, and the run log names it, until it carries them.
